ModMetaData.name: MP3 Audio Bootstrap [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Let compatible audio fixes on macOS load local WAV copies before RimWorld reads the original MP3 files FEATURES The loader redirects audio only when the original files match the fix's manifest and the local WAV files are present. If either check fails, the game uses the original audio files HOW TO USE Install a compatible audio fix such as Biomes Caverns Fixes and follow its local audio setup instructions COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077). Load Harmony first, then MP3 Audio Bootstrap, then Core. If you use Faster Game Loading, put it after MP3 Audio Bootstrap FEEDBACK Found a bug?
